correctness.rationale: For the standard Clebsch Cayley graph on F_2^4 with directions 1,2,4,8,15, the open-neighborhood complex has 16 vertices and f=(16,80,160,80,16). Every four-vertex 2-cycle must be an induced missing tetrahedron. Exactly forty such sets are the four cosets of each of ten affine planes determined by direction triples. The integer chain complex has rank partial_2=65 and rank partial_3=64, so ker partial_2 has rank 95. A 95x95 submatrix of 64 tetrahedron-boundary chains and 31 sphere cycles has determinant -1, proving an integral basis of cycles and H_2=Z^31. Affine F_2^4 semidirect S_5 is transitive on forty supports, so each is a primitive shortest nonzero class and their relation lattice is free of rank nine.
